lines:
flowchart TD
    Start["Approved static layered SVG mockup design"] --> Foundation["Task 1: Extension foundation"]
    Foundation --> Schema["Add schema migration and mockup domain model"]
    Schema --> Runtime["Implement shared runtime, SVG policy, revision lifecycle, and project revision bumps"]
    Runtime --> Raster["Render deterministic PNG from the same SVG viewport and fonts"]
    Raster --> MCP["Add pending-list and revision-context MCP tools with mixed SVG, metadata, edit log, annotations, and PNG content"]
    MCP --> DesignAPI["Extend design retrieval, transactional save, target resolution, task links, and QA links for mockups"]
    DesignAPI --> App["Integrate local Mockup tabs, workspace, comparison, request, accept, reject, discard, and delete actions"]
    App --> FoundationTests["Migration, sanitization, revision, MCP payload, image-content, and Tauri integration tests"]
    FoundationTests --> FoundationGate{"Foundation contract passes"}
    FoundationGate -->|No| Schema
    FoundationGate -->|Yes| Editor["Task 2: Layered SVG mockup editor"]
    Editor --> Canvas["Build selectable grouped SVG canvas and inline text editing"]
    Canvas --> Manipulation["Add drag, resize, add, edit, delete, duplicate, group, ungroup, and z-order controls"]
    Manipulation --> Palette["Add panel, text, button, field, image placeholder, and divider primitives"]
    Palette --> History["Add undo and redo with recoverable draft persistence"]
    History --> Pencil["Add red pencil, eraser, optional text callouts, and separate annotation layer"]
    Pencil --> RevisionUX["Connect dirty state and Request AI revision workflow"]
    RevisionUX --> EditorTests["Unit, interaction, persistence, visual, and real Tauri runtime QA"]
    EditorTests --> Done["Two implementation tasks ready for execution"]
